## Clockwork Buccaneer (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
N Medium construct (clockwork)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft, low-light vision; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 28, touch 16, flat-footed 22 (+6 Dex, +12 natural)  
**hp** 86 (12d10+20)  
**Fort** +4 **Ref** +10 **Will** +6  
**DR** 10/adamantine; **Immune** construct traits  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to electricity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** scimitar +18/+13/+8 (1d6+7/18-20)  
**Ranged** arm gun +16 (1d8, scatter)  
**Special Attacks** pirate’s feint, water jet (DC 18)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 22, **Con** -, **Int** -, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +17; **CMD** 33  
**Feats** Ability Focus (water jet), Improved Feint, Improved Vital Strike,Vital Strike  
**Skills** Bluff -5 (+10 to feint); Racial Modifiers +8 Bluff to feint only  
**Languages** Common (can’t speak)  
**SQ** water tank  


**Special Abilities**


**Arm Gun (Ex)** The clockwork buccaneer’s arm gun has the statistics of a blunderbuss and uses firearm rules, but counts as a natural weapon. When the clockwork buccaneer makes a full attack, it can make one attack with the arm gun as a secondary weapon at -5 to hit. Using its internal mechanisms, the clockwork buccaneer can reload as a move action.
